title: Boowomp
blurb: Two notes, descending, and the enthusiasm is gone. The boowomp is SpongeBob's small-failure sting and arguably the most useful sad sound ever animated: nothing has been destroyed, nobody is hurt, there is just a quiet oh where the excitement used to be. Meme culture adopted it for anticlimaxes, politely worded rejections and the exact moment optimism meets logistics. Curiously, it gets funnier the smaller the disappointment it accompanies — a failed heist deserves an orchestra, whereas a vending machine eating your coin deserves precisely this and nothing more.
origin: The classic deflated sting from SpongeBob SquarePants, adopted for gentle failures.
